notes_for_editor: Unresolved conflict: the register gives built 1935 with no source on its page; the 2026 blog says the construction date and builder are not publicly documented. The story reports the register's date and flags that it is unconfirmed. A Facebook video description gives the height as 99 ft 9 in, but it could not be read or cited, so height_m is omitted. The register names the private buyer of the 2018 auction; the story says 'a private buyer' and the evidence quote leaves the name out. The record's federal ownership is proposed for correction to private. Treat as private property; no public access described.
